patch.summary: Getscreen.me migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Getscreen.me by inventorying legacy project-management fields, mapping them to Getscreen.me objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Windows, Macos, Linux before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Adjacent remote-access tool — not a project management platform
Success signal: automations and workflows works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Getscreen.me migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power automations and workflows, docs and collaboration, reporting dashboards and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Getscreen.me; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Windows; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Support and IT teams needing remote desktop / screen share outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Adjacent remote-access tool — not a project management platform
If Getscreen.me mapping is poor, compare destination fit with monday.com before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Windows in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Adjacent remote-access tool — not a project management platform

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Hybrid user + device pricing means TCO rises with device count

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Free is capped at 1 user / 2 devices

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for automations and workflows
Mitigate: Adjacent remote-access tool — not a project management platform

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
